author: Teh_Senpai
body:
Hello..I am utterly shocked by this but about 3 weeks ago, Da_Baus released this map Christmas Combat http://avicus.net/forums/90b96c038?page=1 I was looking at this map and it seems that he did not actually make the map. If you go into his map it says it was made by a guy called Cubal5. So I searched Christmas courtyard on the internet and I found this. http://minecraftmaps.org/minecraft-pvp-maps/christmas-combat/ This map is not made by Da_Baus, but by Cubal 5...This is a direct violation of map making I believe, and action should be taken, it is wrong to steal maps just so you can post it on another server..i hope you look into this and take action as requested..Thank you for reading this
~Brian
